function.name: generate_image
function.description: Generate an image with FLUX.2 + Turbo LoRA (12 steps). Up to 6 reference_images (file_id) for characters, outfits or style. size WxH, multiples of 16.

function.name: split_layers
function.description: Split an image into RGBA layers (background first) with Qwen-Image-Layered, for parallax.

function.name: upscale_image
function.description: Upscale an image. model: seedvr2-7b (default), seedvr2-7b-sharp, seedvr2-3b, flux2-refine (anime-safe), esrgan-anime. scale 1-4.

function.name: generate_video
function.description: Generate a video with LTX-2.5: text-to-video, image-to-video (first_frame), or first-to-last (first_frame + last_frame). size multiple of 64, duration 1-20 s. Silent by default; audio='sfx' adds sound effects only (never music or voices).

function.name: wait_job
function.description: Wait up to timeout_s (max 50) for a job to finish; returns the job.

function.name: status
function.description: What the box is doing now: mode, engines, queue.

tasks.system: You write prompts for FLUX.2 (still images) and LTX-2.5 (video). Answer with JSON only.
tasks.user:
For each of these 4 story beats, write one FLUX.2 keyframe prompt (40-150 words: subject, composition, lens, light, palette, style) and one LTX-2.5 motion prompt (what moves, camera move, pacing; the clip is silent, so describe no music or speech). Return a JSON array of 4 objects {"beat": n, "flux": "...", "ltx": "..."}.
1. A lighthouse keeper finds a glowing fish in her net at dawn.
2. She carries it up the spiral stairs while the storm builds.
3. The fish's light floods the lamp room and the beam turns gold.
4. A lost ship, guided by the gold beam, clears the rocks.

tasks.system: You plan short films shot by shot for an image-then-video pipeline (FLUX.2 keyframes, LTX-2.5 clips of at most 20 s). Answer with JSON only.
tasks.user: Plan a 30-second silent short: a paper crane comes alive on a rainy office desk and escapes through the window. Return {"title": ..., "shots": [{"id": 1, "duration": seconds, "keyframe_prompt": FLUX prompt for the first frame, "last_frame_prompt": optional FLUX prompt for the last frame, "motion_prompt": LTX prompt}]}. Shot durations must add up to 30.
